candidates.angle: Krishna calls desire, anger and greed the three gates of ruin
candidates.evidence: कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् (Desire, anger, and greed are the three gates of ruin, therefore abandon these three)

candidates.angle: Krishna tells Arjuna to abandon all three to save the self
The three enemies that make clear action impossible
candidates.evidence: कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभः (Desire, anger, and greed)

en.intro: Krishna names the three inner enemies that block the path of right action. Listen to how he groups them.
en.notice: Krishna does not list these as separate sins. He calls them a threefold gate, a single entrance that leads the self into ruin.
en.next: Freed from these three gates, a person acts for their own good and reaches the highest state.
en.meaning: Desire, anger, and greed are the three gates of ruin. Abandon these three.

hi.intro: कृष्ण उन तीन आंतरिक शत्रुओं का नाम लेते हैं जो सही कर्म के रास्ते को रोकते हैं। सुनिए, वे इन्हें कैसे एक साथ रखते हैं।
hi.meaning: काम, क्रोध और लोभ ये तीन प्रकारके नरकके दरवाजे जीवात्माका पतन करनेवाले हैं, इसलिये इन तीनोंका त्याग कर देना चाहिये ॥
hi.notice: कृष्ण इन्हें अलग-अलग पाप नहीं कहते। वे इन्हें एक त्रिविध द्वार, यानी एक ही रास्ता कहते हैं जो आत्मा को विनाश की ओर ले जाता है।
hi.next: इन तीन अंधकार के द्वारों से मुक्त होकर, मनुष्य अपने भले के लिए कर्म करता है और सर्वोच्च पद को प्राप्त करता है।

en.intro: Krishna names the three inner enemies that block the path of right action. Listen to how he groups them.
en.body: Desire, anger, and greed are the three gates of ruin. Abandon these three. Krishna does not list these as separate sins. He calls them a threefold gate, a single entrance that leads the self into ruin. Freed from these three gates, a person acts for their own good and reaches the highest state.
